question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Sachin and Sehwag are / great batsmen / but the former is greater / than latter.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "the" before "latter".
 
• In comparisons, "the former" and "the latter" are typically used to refer to the first and second items mentioned, respectively.
 
• The correct phrase should be "than the latter," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
